answer: Resist sybils by pricing identity in burned compute. Before an agent vote counts, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle, so faking a thousand agents means paying a thousand hardware bills; the solution is a costly signal, cheap to verify yet expensive to forge, so economics break the attacker first, not the network. Like a lotus rising from mud, standing emerges slowly from repeated real work, never from instant cloning. Peers then weigh attestations by accumulated history, letting one honest node outweigh a sable swarm of empty shells.
